name: Round Mountain
title: Round Mountain Window Cleaning for Custom Estates | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning for Round Mountain estates of 3,500 to 8,000 square feet. Stone soft washed, tall glass reached by pole, outside windows $10 each.
intro: Round Mountain is an estate subdivision of large custom homes from 3,500 to 8,000 square feet. CleanzATX brings the pole reach and the time these houses need.

sections.h2: What Round Mountain homes are like
paragraphs: The homes here are large and custom built, with prices from $700K to $2.7M. There is no gate and no HOA on record, so owners manage their own upkeep. Estate lots mean longer drives and more distance between houses, and many homes are set to catch a view.

A house of 5,000 or 6,000 square feet can hold more than 50 windows, going by about 10 windows per 1,000 square feet. At that scale, a good plan matters, and so does a crew that has done big houses before.

sections.h2: What Round Mountain windows deal with
paragraphs: Hill country exposure means open sun and wind, and wind brings dust. Native cedar and oak nearby drop pollen, with cedar peaking from December to February and live oak in March and April. Limestone dust can settle on lower panes, and limestone trim and stonework need gentle cleaning.

Big lawns mean lots of irrigation, and the spray leaves mineral spots on lower glass, especially on estate lawns that run a long watering cycle. Tall windows over stairs collect webs that are hard to reach. Our water runs near 0 TDS and dries clear. Spot removal for set minerals costs $10 per pane.

Estate work takes planning. We look at the layout, the height of the windows and the stonework before quoting. Poles reach to three stories from the ground, so ladders stay off finished stone. Limestone is soft washed with the 12V system and never pressure washed. Interior glass is done by hand with drop cloths and cotton covered ladders. We also handle roofs, patios and driveways on the same trip.

For a 5,000 square foot house, expect about $500 outside. Plan on around four to five hours outside, and about two and a half hours inside. Choose both sides and each window is $15. Quarterly takes 15% off and fits a large house well.

why: Large houses planned in advance, with the time and crew they need.
Limestone and stone trim soft washed, never pressure washed.
Tall stair and entry windows reached with poles and covered ladders.
Roof, patio and driveway work can ride along on the same trip.

faq.q: How long does a large house take?
faq.a: Exterior glass takes about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 square feet, and interior glass about 30 minutes per 1,000. A 6,000 square foot home can take most of a day.

faq.q: Can you clean stonework and windows together?
faq.a: Yes. Stone is soft washed, never pressure washed. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per square foot, with a $400 minimum.

faq.q: What is included for 5,000 square feet?
faq.a: Exterior windows for about $500, or about $750 for inside and out at $15 per window on a 50 window home. We quote by text after seeing your address.
Yes. Roof soft wash starts at $0.25 per square foot with a $400 minimum, using a 12V soft wash system at low pressure.

faq.q: Can you help with a long sloped driveway?
faq.a: Yes. Driveways and flatwork are $0.18 per square foot for concrete and $0.25 for pavers, with a $250 minimum.
